wallets.name: Rabby
wallets.note: Pairs through the AirGap Vault option of Rabby. Lensly reads Rabby's signing requests and answers them in the same code format.
wallets.limitations: A change in Rabby's code format stops signing until a signed registry package adds the new format. Rabby's requests name the signing address, and Lensly checks it against the shown account.

wallets.name: MetaMask
wallets.note: Pairs through the QR-based hardware wallet option of MetaMask. Lensly reads MetaMask's signing requests and answers them in the same code format.
wallets.limitations: MetaMask's requests do not name the signing address, so Lensly checks the account from its derivation path alone. A change in MetaMask's code format stops signing until a signed registry package adds the new format.
